_comment: Checkpoint manifest for the weiqi time machine. The demo builds one slider stop per entry; adding future checkpoints only needs new files + new entries here — no code changes.

selfplay.about: PPO from scratch vs frozen snapshots of itself (M1/MPS, corrected training semantics). At 6M the net is 8-24 vs GNU Go levels 1-10 (greedy play), roughly on par with the 3M result (5-27); it holds level 10 to 4-4 but still drops games to the weaker levels' noisier moves.
selfplay.label: Self-play RL
